name: Rod of Lordly Might
description: A flanged rod of dark iron with six studs along its haft.
body:
## What it does

It fights as a magic mace that strikes far truer and harder than a plain one. Once a day each, it can paralyze a creature it hits, drain the life of one it hits, or terrify everyone around you.

## Studs

Pressing one of six studs turns it into a blade of flame, a battleaxe or a spear, a climbing pole of up to 50 feet, a battering ram, or a compass that also tells depth and height. Pressing none returns it to a rod.

damage.note: once per dawn, to drain life on a hit, unless the target makes a DC 17 Constitution save; you regain half

features.name: Paralyze
features.text: Once per dawn, on a hit, the target makes a DC 17 Strength save or is paralyzed for a minute.

features.name: Terrify
features.text: Once per dawn, as an action, each creature you can see within 30 feet makes a DC 17 Wisdom save or is frightened of you for a minute.
